desc: Whether it's wingshooting, competitive shooting, hunting, or just busting clays with your friends, the new Ace Paloma has all the features to satisfy your needs.The ACE is powered by Retay’s Straight Line Inertial Transfer System, the patented Inertia Plus Bolt Rollover Torsion Spring Action, and the Dead Straight Deep-Bore Drilled Barrel for maximum performance. It offers on target, no float aiming and Retay’s Out of the Box Optimization Factory- Lengthened Forcing Cone.
